svg.title: AI video generation pipeline v3 workflow
svg.desc: A six-row production workflow from intake and rights review through reference intelligence, creative pre-production, structure approval, generation control, delivery and disclosure, and guarded publication. Four human approval gates labelled A, B, C, and D authorize downstream cost and exposure. Rejection arrows return to the nearest owning stage. A declared degradation ladder provides an escape path so that one unachievable shot cannot block a release. A separate strip shows the per-shot lifecycle, which advances independently of the project phase. A control plane panel enforces the two-level state machine, typed dependency invalidation, the continuity ledger, budget admission and escrow, typed human direction, and provenance with synthetic media disclosure.
svg.text: Two-level state machine, typed invalidation, continuity ledger, budget admission, and four human gates

g.text: No match is a valid outcome

svg.text: Gate A reject: revise only the affected shots
Retry inside the shot budget and stop-loss
Gate B reject: regenerate or reselect one shot
Gate C reject: repair the owning delivery stage

g.text: The true point of no return
Simplify motion, reroute, animate a still, substitute coverage, cut and retime,
then escalate as a production decision
Every step needs an approval level and is recorded as a named deviation

svg.text: Reachable from generation, quality control, and delivery stages
PER-SHOT LIFECYCLE, ADVANCING INDEPENDENTLY OF PROJECT PHASE
Side states reachable from most stages: BLOCKED, DEGRADED, and CUT. Regression is cheap; only advancement is gated.

g.text: Stop-loss and a measured rate card
Free text is rationale, never payload
Approval binds an edit fingerprint plus
No paid generation before Gate A.
No public visibility before Gate D.

svg.text: Solid arrows: forward progress | Dashed red: reject or repair | Dotted orange: declared degradation
